source.name: CMA CGM Group — Partnerships: sport (OM main partner, logo on the jersey)
source.quote: As of July 1, 2023, CMA CGM Group became the new main partner of Olympique de Marseille for two seasons. We are proud to see our logo now featured on the jersey of the emblematic club in the city where CMA CGM was born nearly 45 years ago.

source.name: CINEWS — « Sublime Côte d'Ivoire » et l'OM prolongent leur partenariat jusqu'en 2029
source.note: Coverage of the renewed 2026-2029 partnership: the logo, previously on the shorts, moves to the shirt sleeve for the new cycle.
source.quote: Alors que le logo figurait jusque-là sur le short de l’équipe marseillaise, il sera désormais apposé sur la manche du maillot de l’Om

source.name: OM Boutique — Maillot OM domicile 2026/27 (product page)
source.note: Kit maker. The club shop's product page for the 2026/27 home shirt.
source.quote: Logos PUMA et Olympique de Marseille

summary: Puma kit. CMA CGM (main partner) on the front; Sublime Côte d'Ivoire, the Côte d'Ivoire state tourism brand, on the sleeve from the 2026-29 partnership cycle. Product photos of the 2026/27 home shirt and shorts show no other sponsor; the back of the neck carries only the gold 'Droit au But' motto.
